statement: A fresh CREATE release on a partition that already has a write origin is answered by the origin shortcut before any operation-row read, so a create no longer open (CLOSED, completed) still reaches cut_over. Close that gap without making the release depend on the group it releases. constraints.statement: Reading replica_operations through the required-leader owner RPC is forbidden for a release of replica_operations itself: a voter target leading before ACTIVE has no routable service, so the read could not succeed until the release completes (source-derived; electability and the canonicalLeaderNodeId source unconfirmed).
An unavailable read may never grant (option C refused).
